name: Surface annotation-based region-of-interest morphometry extraction
purpose: Read FreeSurfer surface annotations, label files and morphometry (curv-type) data to obtain per-vertex labels and regional surface measurements for ROI analysis.

inputs.statement: Optionally a FreeSurfer .label file giving vertex indices, with optional per-vertex scalars.
Optionally a triangular surface mesh geometry file supplying vertex coordinates and faces.
inputs.quote: Read a triangular format Freesurfer surface mesh.

steps.statement: Read the annotation file to obtain the label id at each vertex, the color table and the label names.
steps.quote: Read in a Freesurfer annotation from a .annot file.

steps.statement: Read the morphometry file to obtain the vector of surface morphometry values.
steps.quote: Vector representation of surface morpometry values

steps.statement: Optionally read the label file to obtain vertex indices included in the label, and scalars if requested.
steps.quote: Array with indices of vertices included in label.

steps.statement: Optionally read the surface geometry to obtain vertex coordinates and mesh faces.
steps.quote: nvtx x 3 array of vertex (x, y, z) coordinates.

steps.statement: Combine per-vertex annotation labels with per-vertex morphometry values to summarise measurements within each annotated region.

checks.statement: Verify that the number of morphometry values matches the number of vertices in the annotation.
Confirm the length of the label names list equals the number of labels in the color table.
checks.quote: The names of the labels. The length of the list is n_labels.

outputs.statement: Per-vertex annotation id array of shape (n_vertices,).
Color table array of shape (n_labels, 5) in RGBT plus label id form.
List of label names with length equal to the number of labels.
Vector of surface morphometry values read from the morphometry file.
outputs.quote: Vector representation of surface morpometry values

parameters.statement: orig_ids flag controlling whether stored vertex ids or positional color table ids are returned.
read_scalars flag controlling whether per-vertex scalars are read and returned from a label file.
read_metadata flag controlling whether geometry metadata key-value pairs are read and returned.
read_stamp flag controlling whether the file comment stamp is returned.

claim.statement: A FreeSurfer annotation (.annot) file containing a label value per vertex plus a color table.
claim.quote: An .annot file contains a sequence of vertices with a label (also known as an “annotation value”) associated with each vertex

claim.statement: A FreeSurfer morphometry file (curv-type, e.g. ?h.curv, ?h.thickness) holding one value per vertex.
claim.quote: This function reads in what Freesurfer internally calls “curv” file types, (e.g. ?h. curv, ?h.thickness)

claim.statement: Annotation file format versions 1 and 2 are supported, corresponding to old-style and new-style color table layouts.
claim.quote: Annotation file format versions 1 and 2 are supported, corresponding to the “old-style” and “new-style” color table layout.

claim.statement: The returned color table is in RGBT form, where transparency T is 255 minus alpha.
claim.quote: Note that the output color table ctab is in RGBT form, where T (transparency) is 255 - alpha.

claim.statement: Morphometry values written must have shape (N,), (N, 1), (1, N) or (N, 1, 1).
claim.quote: Surface morphometry values. Shape must be (N,), (N, 1), (1, N) or (N, 1, 1)

claim.statement: With orig_ids=False, vertices that belong to no label are assigned an id of -1.
claim.quote: If a vertex does not belong to any label and orig_ids=False, its id will be set to -1.

claim.statement: With orig_ids=True, vertex ids are returned as stored in the annotation file rather than positional color table ids.
claim.quote: Whether to return the vertex ids as stored in the annotation file or the positional colortable ids.
